title: Lilac Mesh Top & Flare Jeans, Hands on Hips
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight black hair falls past her shoulders and wears layered silver necklaces. She wears a lilac long-sleeve mesh top with a scoop neckline, a sheer lace-trimmed bodice, and a center zip, over dark flare jeans with a wide embellished metal belt. Her hands rest at her hips, and her expression is calm. Soft, even studio light against a plain white backdrop. Palette of lilac, charcoal denim, and silver. Delicate and playful, in the style of a Y2K lookbook.
workingNotes:
- This is an alternate angle of the lilac mesh set in section 147; keep only one if you do not need both.
